contentHtml:
Abu Dhabi’s freelancer license has created an incredible opportunity. Specifically for individuals starting their businesses or side hustles. The freelancer license is becoming increasingly popular. A simple and affordable setup process makes it more lucrative. Popular among professionals who wish to operate independently.

This article walks you through the:

  • Essentials of the Freelance Business License Abu Dhabi​
  • From its benefits to eligibility
  • The application process, and
  • The most popular freelance activities.

What is a Freelancer License UAE?

A freelancer is an individual. He/she has a specific skill set. One who offers their expertise to organizations on an ad hoc basis. These individuals are not bound by an employment contract. It means they can work for multiple clients simultaneously. They are free without being considered employees.

Is the Freelancer License Right for You?

Are you a freelancer?
A freelance business license is a great choice. Only if you have a specialized skill. With this skill set, you can offer your services. Provide on a flexible and independent basis. Freelancers are self-employed professionals. Those who work on specific projects or assignments. They have the liberty to collaborate with multiple organizations/individuals. They are different from full-time employees.

A freelance is earning money by selling your work/services. You are open to offering to multiple organizations. Rather than being employed by a single one. This is what the freelancer license allows you to do in Abu Dhabi.

Why Do You Need a Freelancer License in Abu Dhabi?

The correct license type is needed to operate a business in Abu Dhabi. If you’re self-employed or offering freelance services, require a license. A work permit and labor card are issued by their employer for employed individuals. Freelancers require either a business license or a freelancer license. This way, they legally provide services.

What Activities Are Available Under the Freelancer License?

There are over 100 business activities available for Abu Dhabi freelancer licenses. These activities span various sectors. They are ideal for those seeking to operate independently in the emirate.

Popular Categories of Freelance Activities:

  • Media & IT: Graphic design, content creation, video editing, web development, and more.
  • Consulting: IT consulting, business consulting, management, and marketing consultancy.
  • Creative & Design: Photography, fashion design, jewelry design, arts, and crafts.
  • Technology & Development: AI development, software development, and gaming consultancy.
  • Other Niche Areas: Energy sector services like oil and gas field services and pest control consultancy.

Key Benefits:

  • Cost-effective: In Abu Dhabi, it is one of the cheapest licenses available.
  • No local sponsor required: This makes it an excellent option for expats.
  • Freedom to work with clients onshore and offshore: Not restricted to any free zone.

Misconceptions About the Freelance Business License Abu Dhabi​

Question Answer
Do I need a local sponsor? No, the freelancer license doesn’t require a local sponsor.
Is a commercial premise required? No, a physical office space is not necessary. You can operate from home or a co-working space.
Can I employ others? No, this license is meant for individuals only. If you want to hire employees, an alternative license, such as an LLC, will be required.
Can I sponsor my family? Freelancers can sponsor family members. However, they must be sponsored under the freelancer’s visa.
Is the freelancer license valid for a year? The freelancer license is issued for one year and is renewable annually.
Can I work with the government? The freelancer license allows you to work with companies. Work with government entities within Abu Dhabi.
What type of visa is required? Operate under your current UAE residency visa. Apply for a new freelancer visa if required.

Who is Eligible for an Abu Dhabi Freelancer License?

A UAE citizen/resident can apply for Abu Dhabi’s freelancer license. You must have an Emirates ID with you. Available to part-time and full-time freelancers. Note that, non-residents are no longer eligible to apply.

Documents required to apply:

  • Full name
  • Passport number
  • Mobile number
  • Email address
  • Proof of expertise in your activity. It can be a university degree or certified work experience
  • A No Objection Certificate from your employer is needed if you’re employed in the government sector.

A NOC is generally not required For private sector employees unless planning to work part-time.

Advantages of the Abu Dhabi Freelancer License

Affordable: The most cost-effective license in Abu Dhabi.

Wide Range of Activities: More activities become eligible for the freelancer license. As a result, it’s opening up more opportunities.

Flexibility: You can work from home. You’re free to choose your clients. You’re open to managing your schedule.

Corporate Bank Account: You can open a corporate bank account for your freelancing business. Do so with a registered trade name, 

Sponsorship: Freelancers can sponsor family members. It provides the flexibility to remain in the UAE with their loved ones.

No Local Sponsorship Required: You won’t need a local partner as an expat. It makes the freelancer license especially appealing.

Process to Obtain a Freelance Business License Abu Dhabi​

The application process for a license is fast and easy. A step-by-step guide is listed. Explore how you can get started:

Step 1: Choose Your Activity
Select the business activity you wish to operate. Choose from the list of approved activities for freelancers.

Step 2: Prepare Required Documents
Ensure you have the necessary documents ready, such as your:

  • Passport
  • Proof of expertise, and
  • Any required NOCs.

Step 3: Submit Your Application
Apply to the Abu Dhabi Department of Economic Development website. Also known as (ADDED) once your documents are ready.

Step 4: Wait for Approval
The application process takes 2-3 business days. On approval, receive your freelancer license.

Step 5: Receive Your License
After approval, you can start freelancing immediately. If you applied for a visa, this will also be processed along with your freelancer license.

Cost of an Abu Dhabi Freelancer License

The business license for freelance work cost is low. As compared to other Abu Dhabi business licenses. The costs range from AED 5,000 to AED 12,000 on an annual basis. Depending on the chosen activity and other factors. This is a great value proposition for individuals just starting out.

Conclusion: Is the Freelancer License Right for You?

The Abu Dhabi freelancer license provides an affordable way. This flexibility enables you to start your own business. From running a full-time freelance operation or establishing a side business while still working. This freelance license offers a great opportunity. The possibilities are expanding rapidly with over 100 business activities available.

The Abu Dhabi freelancer license is ideal for skilled professionals. Perfect for housewives seeking to contribute to household income. It can be best for those who wish to continue living and working in the UAE. Meanwhile, maintain their independence.
